subject: Urgent exam timetable update
body: Review the examination timetable before the end-semester exams. Carry your hall ticket.

subject: Assignment 3 submission deadline
body: Important: submit the Data Structures assignment through the LMS before the deadline.

subject: Placement drive registration closes
body: Important: register for the campus placement drive and upload your resume before registration closes.

subject: Hostel room inspection next week
body: Routine room inspection will take place next week. Keep your room tidy.

subject: Annual campus fest registration
body: Join the cultural fest volunteer team. Registration details are available on the student portal.

subject: Weekly library update
body: This week's library digest includes new books and opening-hour updates. Unsubscribe from this newsletter at any time.

subject: Fee payment deadline reminder
body: Your semester fee is due. Complete payment through the official ERP portal before the last date.

subject: Scholarship application forms available
body: Download the scholarship application form and submit supporting documents to the student office.

subject: Hostel mess menu for this week
body: The hostel mess menu has been updated. Share feedback with the committee if you have dietary requests.

subject: Inter-college sports meet
body: Registrations for the sports competition are open. Volunteers can sign up with the club.

subject: Certificate and ID card collection
body: Collect your student ID card and enrollment certificate from the administrative office.

subject: Viva schedule published
body: Important: the viva schedule and course timetable are now available. Check the academic portal for your slot.

subject: Interview shortlist announcement
body: Important: shortlisted students should confirm their interview slot for the internship drive by the deadline.

subject: Laundry room maintenance notice
body: The hostel laundry room will be closed for routine maintenance on Saturday.

subject: Weekly society newsletter
body: Read the weekly newsletter for upcoming seminars, club meetups, and campus events. No action required.
